pages.text: You've noticed that there are still more Illagers who have yet to join your tribe. With your knowledge of them, you believe you can bring them all under your command.
Disease-ridden outlanders spread terrible plagues among their enemies—fortunately, this time they won't infect you or your allies.
These Illagers, specialized in hunting mages, possess high resistance to magic. They also throw potions at enemies or cast spells to heal themselves.
As a variant of the Royal Guard, the Crimson Guard excels at harvesting life force from enemies. The more damage they deal to a foe, the more health they recover from it.
